label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering at eighteen sharp in the town hall, with bread, lanterns, an escort and a private community presentation. The gathering itself was disclosed and approved, but presentation details remain withheld; it may mark my forty years of service, though that is only a guess. Innkeeper organizes hosting and escort and offers a personal bread guarantee; freight coordinates supplies, builder relays escort arrangements and carried grain material, and baker appears involved in bread preparation. Secretary knowingly assists scheduling and communications without authorizing municipal spending.
